About.title: A specialist agency built to expand reinsurance capacity across the continent.
About.lead: Anchor Risk Transfer Private Limited is a licensed Underwriting Management Agency headquartered in Mauritius, dedicated to serving the African reinsurance market. We specialise in tailored solutions for classes of business that require technical expertise and innovative structures.
About.body: Our mandate is to strengthen partnerships between reinsurers and cedants — offering transparent, well-structured placements and binder facilities that respond to evolving market needs. We combine deep technical knowledge with a commitment to integrity, efficiency, and client-focused service.

Services.title: Reliable, market-backed solutions — and seamless claims.
Services.lead: Our dedicated team serves every corner of Africa, providing capacity to clients who need it and supporting their growth. We are equally committed to a rapid, seamless claims process — timely support and transparent service at every stage.
Services.s1Body: Structured binder agreements that give cedants efficient access to reinsurance capacity, with streamlined placement and administration of risks.
Services.s2Body: Tailored placement of complex risks across multiple classes, backed by deep technical underwriting expertise and robust market relationships.
Services.s3Body: Partnering with reinsurers to expand capacity in underserved markets — strengthening resilience and supporting sustainable, profitable growth.
Services.s4Body: Guidance on reinsurance structures, pricing and risk appetite to help cedants and brokers make informed, confident decisions.

Classes.title: Eight classes, written with technical depth.
Classes.lead: From property and engineering to political violence and energy, we structure cover for the risks that define African markets — and the specialist lines that need real expertise.
Classes.c1Items: Fire & Allied Perils · Property All Risks · Machinery Breakdown · Business Interruption
Classes.c2Items: CAR / EAR · Third Party Liability · Plant All Risks · Deterioration of Stock
Classes.c3Items: Cargo · Hull · Associated Third Party Liability
Classes.c4Items: Public · Products · Employers · Professional Indemnity · D&O · Freight Forwarders · Hauliers · Carriers · Broadform · Cyber
Classes.c5Items: Terrorism · Sabotage · Riots · Strikes · Civil Commotion · Malicious Damage · Insurrection · Coup d'État · Civil War
Classes.c6Items: Personal Accident · Burglary / Theft · Money · Goods in Transit · Fidelity Guarantee · Commercial Crime · Bonds

Capacity.title: Global securities, deployed where Africa needs them most.
Capacity.lead: Anchor has secured underwriting capacity from financially strong, market-leading reinsurers worldwide — committed to supporting growth in every corner of the continent.
Capacity.point1Body: Global reach with a primary focus on Africa and the Indian Ocean markets, supported by strong reinsurance securities.
Capacity.point2Body: We partner with AA-rated markets to ensure security and credibility in every risk-transfer arrangement.
Capacity.point3Body: Capacity providers well established in their territories, with strong claims-payment records and significant appetite for the continent.

Claims.title: Delegated claims authority, handled with care.
Claims.lead: Anchor acts as the delegated claims administrator under binder arrangements on behalf of reinsurers — receiving notifications, validating and settling within authority, recording every loss, and managing recoveries and bordereaux to binder and regulatory terms.
Claims.step1Body: Prompt logging and acknowledgement of every claim as it is received.
Claims.step2Body: Policy and coverage checks, with adjusters appointed where required.
Claims.step3Body: Settlements within delegated authority; larger or complex losses escalated to reinsurers.
Claims.step4Body: Reinsurance recoveries, bordereaux and periodic claims reports prepared in line with binder terms.

Values.title: The principles behind every decision.
Values.lead: We prioritise honest dealings, place clients at the centre, foster durable partnerships, and continuously innovate to strengthen the African reinsurance industry.
Values.v1Body: Honest, transparent dealings on every placement.
Values.v2Body: Clear terms, clear reporting, no surprises.
Values.v3Body: Clients at the centre of every solution we build.
Values.v4Body: Durable relationships between reinsurers and cedants.

Team.title: Deep market knowledge, proven expertise.
Team.lead: Anchor's team brings over twenty years' experience across the insurance, broking and reinsurance spaces — delivering high-level underwriting and claims services that support client growth and operational resilience.
Team.r1Body: Robust underwriting decisions across all classes.
Team.r3Body: Proactive structuring for cedants and brokers.
